comparison.objective: Break a circuit board from its panel over an edge and tray it, versus collet-nut preassembly.
comparison.physical_skill: Controlled bending/fracture and post-separation handling; candidate uses nondestructive insertion and snap retention.
comparison.success_condition: Board must separate cleanly and be placed safely; candidate forbids deformation/damage and requires retained engagement. Candidate force limits are unspecified.
comparison.reason: The core physical transformations are opposite: controlled separation versus nondestructive assembly.
